newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-WEAH TO ATTEND LISBON CEREMONY, FIFA SAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEAH TO ATTEND LISBON CEREMONY, FIFA SAY.

text.p: AC Milan striker George Weah, facing a law suit in Portugal, will attend the FIFA player of the year award in Lisbon on Monday. Weah, last year's winner, has been short-listed for the honour along with fellow marksmen Ronaldo of Barcelona and Alan Shearer of Newcastle.

The Liberian was missing from a pre-ceremony news conference attended by his two rivals, but FIFA spokesman Keith Cooper said that the Liberian, being sued by Porto defender Jorge Costa over a broken nose, would arrive from Italy in time for the 2000 GMT ceremony.
"He is about to board a plane in Milan," Cooper said. Earlier FIFA had said that it did not know whether the player would be present.
Costa was out of action for six weeks after being butted by Weah at the end of a tense European Champions' League match between Porto and Milan last November.

Weah, due to receive the FIFA's fair-play award later this month in Lisbon, admitted lashing out at Costa in a "moment of craziness". But he said that he had been provoked by the tough-tackling Porto defender.
The Liberian said last week that he might not travel to Lisbon because he feared legal problems over the suit for damages that Costa has taken against him in Porto.
Past player of the year winners: Romario, Roberto Baggio, Lothar Matthaeus, Marco Van Basten, Weah.
